The source is unmodified. Bytecoin selects `RANDOMX_FLAG_V2` at its dormant RandomX hard-fork
boundary and uses light mode for consensus verification. Any update is consensus-sensitive and must
repeat upstream provenance, deterministic-vector, multi-architecture and reorg testing.
